title: The cmpivot timeout and BP-c552cb0f answer regexes are case-sensitive at scoring, so 'Ten minutes' or 'One hour' fails, and '0.1 hour' passes
goal: The answer regexes of the six cmpivot timeout rows and of BP-c552cb0f match as agent_bench scores them (re.search with no flags): they take a capitalised 'Ten minutes' or 'One hour' and reject '0.1 hour'; pool check passes

run: import re,sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_pool as b;R={r['id']:json.loads(r['checks'])[0] for r in b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE)};r=[bool(re.search(R['BP-d306eaa8'],'Ten minutes from the Intune admin center.')),bool(re.search(R['BP-d306eaa8'],'One hour.')),not re.search(R['BP-d306eaa8'],'0.1 hour')];print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)
